images.title: 4 kg 200 g and 4,020 g on a number line
images.purpose: Show that once both weights are in grams they can be compared as numbers: 4 kg 200 g is 4,200 g, which is further along than 4,020 g.
images.composition: One number line in grams with two marked points, the weight in kg and g joined to its grams, and the comparison written below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. NUMBER LINE: one thin dark #1F2937 horizontal line at y 400 from x 150 to x 1306 representing 4,000 g to 4,300 g (3.85 px per g), with four tall tick marks (44 px) at x 150, 535, 921 and 1306 labelled under the line 4,000 g, 4,100 g, 4,200 g and 4,300 g (36 px, dark, y 470). POINT A: a teal #0072B2 dot (28 px) on the line at x 227 with the label 4,020 g above it (44 px, bold, teal) in a rounded rectangle 220 by 64 px at y 290 to 354. POINT B: an amber #E69F00 dot (28 px) on the line at x 921 with the label 4,200 g above it (44 px, bold, amber-dark) in a rounded rectangle 220 by 64 px at y 290 to 354, and under it, at y 560, a tag 4 kg 200 g (40 px, bold) joined to the dot by a thin grey #6B7280 line with an equals sign (=) in the middle. A thin grey bracket above the line from x 227 to x 921 at y 250 (the gap between the two points) with the text 180 g more (36 px, dark) centred above it at y 215. RESULT at the bottom centre, y 700: the text 4,200 > 4,020 (72 px, bold, dark #1F2937) so that the larger number is on the right of the line. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of tick marks that differs from 4, or a point that is not at 4,020 or 4,200
the comparison sign pointing the wrong way
any unit other than g on the line
images.takeaway: Change both weights to grams, then the larger number is the heavier weight: 4 kg 200 g > 4,020 g.
images.description: A number line in grams with 4,020 g and 4,200 g marked, 4 kg 200 g joined to 4,200 g, and 4,200 > 4,020.
images.context: Concept image for Comparing Weights in Different Units. It follows the idea of comparing weights in your maths book and shows the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Ask which point is further along the line. The slip to watch: comparing 4 and 4,020 without a common unit.

image_decisions.why: Both weights on one line in one unit make the comparison a matter of position.
